inputs.text: [panicked] Draconia, say something. I can't see your face. Did it hit you? Did anything come over the table?
[shaken] I'm here. I don't think I'm hit. Give me a moment. Your hand's still in mine, Harry. You can stop searching for it.
[panicked] That wasn't there before. The string was round my wrist, not there. Why have you got the same thing?
[shaken] I don't know. I can see it's the same mark. I don't know why it's on both of us.
[panicked] We broke the step. The chandelier hit the ice. I saw it happen. Tell me that did something besides put these on us.
